provenance: Self-written sentences, each output reviewed by hand. Owner verdict 10-11: a loanword Vietnamese readers settled on one Vietnamese reading (quán net -> nét) is read that way by every voice; verdict 10-11 on "admin BAN nick": capitals written for emphasis keep that reading (ban), they do not make the word English or an abbreviation. English runs ("Game over", "BAN THE HAMMER", "I like you") and names inside a sentence ("gặp Net", "biết Nick", "Code Breaker") keep their own route. direct = VieNeu (direct English), plain = every other voice before its own engine step.
